name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia kills 2 on 24 Nov; Russia says it downed 699 Ukrainian drones overnight
state: A Russian night strike on Zaporizhzhia on 24 Nov killed two civilians and wounded more than 40, including an infant, regional officials said (Al Jazeera). Russia's defence ministry said it downed 699 Ukrainian drones overnight, about half heading for the Moscow region, and Vnukovo and Sheremetyevo flights were restricted; Libya's foreign ministry on 23 Nov denounced Ukraine's 22 Nov naval-drone strike on a Russian corvette at Benghazi (AP). The UN puts civilian deaths since February 2022 at close to 18,000. Mass strikes and the war's widening reach keep the Alert.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine and to Russian regions near the border carries acute risk; follow FCDO travel advice. Wide-scale drone and missile strikes keep disrupting Ukrainian power and Russian airports, and debris has fallen in neighbouring NATO states.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass-casualty strikes and widening reach (Ukrainian strike on Russian warship in Libya, 22 Nov); 699 drones claimed downed by Russia 24 Nov

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Russian strike kills two in Ukraine, days after ship attack off Libya
